seed_governance.prohibition_notes: Union of existing historical/opened/training/validation/demo/development seeds, ineligible for fresh confirmation. Existing scientific roles are preserved, not reassigned. Seed 406737 remains retired SPECK development; seed 260926 remains SIMON development. Author authorization required after complete freeze.

sample_size_specification.verification_policy: Two independent known plaintext/ciphertext blocks (two observations), disjoint from attack plaintexts; excluded from rankers and SAT formulas.

resource_limits.candidate_cutoff_type: Advisory cooperative conflict-checkpoint limit to solver
resource_limits.ranking_limit_enforcement: Bao ranking subprocess: interrupt at 120 seconds. Classical/B1: check after queue construction; only the 300-second parent watchdog is hard for all arms.

diagnostic_control.governance_note: Diagnostic only; neither autonomous attack nor mathematical upper bound. Solved keys do not prove absence of all encoding defects or false UNSATs.

full_pairs_used_telemetry.description: Completed queue methods record selected attack-pair count; SAT-only phase records selected pairs. Early interruption before a phase record leaves usage unknown.

interrupted_sat_solving_telemetry.description: Active candidate/unguided solve interruption uses shared monotonic clocks and excludes startup/journal-read time; completed unguided phases retain solving duration. Invalid timestamps are flagged. Verification, guided initial formula construction and rebuild interruption still need phase-accounting repair; completed guided solving currently includes verification time as well.

b1_training_rule_deviation.description: B0/B1 trainer did not enforce manifest patience=3 or 21,600s total cap, and omitted preflight/generation wall time from log. Preserved as audited; model checkpoint is frozen without retuning.

primary_family.multiplicity: Holm step-down across these two tests

secondary_contrasts.complete_policy_comparison: hybrid_8parent vs fully_neural_1parent changes Stage 2 and parent/queue width; not an isolated Stage-2 effect
secondary_contrasts.fixed_b1: faithful_b1_hybrid vs fixed baselines; no ARX inductive-bias mechanism claim
secondary_contrasts.formula_and_queue_controls: guided arms vs sat_only_n4 and width-matched random controls

power_sensitivity.interpretation: Hypothetical paired alternatives, not predictions or adequate-power guarantees for head-to-head superiority

stop_and_reporting_rules.result_independent_stop_rule: Full fixed N x 9 assignment required; preserve every failure/exception; no outcome-based stopping, seed replacement or retuning. Infrastructure suspension/repair must be documented and reviewed against frozen execution identity.
stop_and_reporting_rules.seed_guard: The confirmation seed remains null and unassigned until explicit author and supervisor authorization recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md.

resource_policy.file_cache_policy: No OS cache clearing; cyclic counterbalancing mitigates rather than eliminates order effects.
resource_policy.solver_lifetime: Independent solver per method-key; reuse after proven UNSAT within method, rebuild after unresolved or failed verification; no cross-method state.
resource_policy.method_order: Cyclic rotation of eight autonomous arms by global instance index; oracle last.
resource_policy.runtime_estimate_limits: Online execution only, not a guarantee; preflight/orchestration and small process-cleanup overhead are additional.

random_control_stream.note: Separate reproducible queue stream; no implicit development-seed default. Must be fixed before unseen seed assignment.

development_resource_locations.note: Existing development locations only. Confirmation must propagate exactly the resolved and full-hash-checked resources into all workers.

execution_readiness.authorization: No unseen seed/data generation or outcome-bearing execution authorized by this draft.

evidence_class_scope: Planned study role only; this proposed manifest is not confirmation evidence.
